needed.evidence: footway exists but is under 1m wide and obstructed by objects.
needed.suggestion: Widen and formalise the footway on the left side to at least 3 meters, ensuring it is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: footway is narrow under 1m and obstructed by objects and parked vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure sufficient width and clearance on the right-side footway for safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: footway obstruction due to pedestrians and informal objects.
needed.suggestion: Enforce pedestrian pathways and provide clear signage to prevent informal obstructions in the left-side footway.

needed.evidence: uneven and potentially hazardous footway surface.
needed.suggestion: Repave and level the uneven left-side footway to ensure it is safe for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: uneven surfaces and potential trip hazards in the footway.
needed.suggestion: Repave and smooth the right-side footway to remove trip hazards and achieve a safer pedestrian environment.

needed.evidence: High crossing demand due to residential and commercial land use without any pedestrian crossing facilities.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at key locations along this road to facilitate safe crossings for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Street lighting is only partially present, causing inadequate lighting at night.
needed.suggestion: Increase the number of streetlights along this urban road to ensure adequate lighting for safety and visibility during nighttime.
